disclaimer: These are prototype validation rules for demonstration purposes. They are modeled after the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 but require official legal verification before production deployment.

rules.title: Product Name Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name or description of the commodity contained in it.
rules.requirement: Product name must be present and legible on the package.

rules.title: Net Quantity Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall bear a declaration of net quantity of the commodity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure.
rules.requirement: Net quantity must be declared in standard units (g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, etc.).

rules.title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) Declaration
rules.description: Every package shall bear the retail sale price of the commodity, known as Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes.
rules.requirement: MRP must be declared in Indian Rupees (₹ or Rs.) with inclusive of all taxes statement.

rules.title: Manufacturer/Packer/Importer Name & Address
rules.description: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer or importer.
rules.requirement: Manufacturer, packer, or importer name and address must be present.

rules.title: Consumer Care Information
rules.description: Every package shall bear the consumer care details including address, telephone, email etc.
rules.requirement: Consumer care information (phone/email/address for complaints) must be present.

rules.title: Date of Manufacture/Packing/Import
rules.description: Every package shall bear the month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed or imported.
rules.requirement: Manufacturing, packing, or import date must be declared (month and year at minimum).

rules.title: Country of Origin (Imported Goods)
rules.description: In case of imported goods, the country of origin shall be mentioned on the package.
rules.requirement: Country of origin must be declared for imported commodities.

rules.title: Common/Generic Name (Optional/Conditional)
rules.description: Where the commodity has a common or generic name different from the trade or brand name, the common name shall also be mentioned.
rules.requirement: Common or generic name of the commodity should be present if different from brand name.

rules.title: Net Quantity Numeric Value Check
rules.description: The net quantity value must be a positive numeric value.
rules.requirement: Net quantity must contain a positive numeric value greater than zero.

rules.title: MRP Numeric Value Check
rules.description: MRP must be a positive numeric value in Indian Rupees.
rules.requirement: MRP must be a positive numeric amount.

rules.title: Unit Declaration Validity
rules.description: Units used in net quantity declaration must be standard metric units.
rules.requirement: Only standard metric units (g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, etc.) are permitted.
